content:
“Quality over quantity!”

**Contractor** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Crafting workshop items now costs fewer materials.

| Rank | Description | Form ID | 
| 1 | Crafting workshop items now costs 25% fewer materials. | 00393F4A | 
| 2 | Crafting workshop items now costs 50% fewer materials. | 003DF404 | 

- This perk synergizes well with Home Defense for creating more advanced turrets and traps, both of which can require significant resources. It also allows more efficient use of PvP workshop resources and makes it cheaper to claim and defend them for the production of resources.
- Although the description says "crafting workshop items," the perk applies to all items built in C.A.M.P.s, workshops and shelters.
